in_marathi.name: Nikhila
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nikhila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nikhila is a Sanskrit name meaning 'complete' or 'all-pervading'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the god Vishnu pervades and protects the universe in its entirety, represented by the name Nikhila. The name signifies the idea of being all-encompassing, all-knowing, and all-powerful.
